name: My Time
source:
After events that happened in the last year of highschool, you decide to cut off from your past and live quiet and peaceful life... or at least that's what you planned to do.

[From [url=https://cysian.itch.io/my-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在高中最后一年发生的事件之后，你决定与过去断绝关系，过上安静祥和的生活……或者至少那是你计划做的。

[来自[url=https://cysian.itch.io/my-time]Itch.io[/url]]
